title: Organoid Drug Response: Differential Expression
description: A differential-expression table from an RNA-seq experiment: one row per gene, treated vs untreated tumour organoids. It went through a collaborator's hands before submission, and something in it no longer holds up. Find it.

columns.base_mean: float, mean normalised read count across samples
columns.log2_fold_change: float, log2 of treated / untreated expression
columns.lfc_se: float, standard error of the log2 fold change
